classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: one cell per slice-1 language-role value (TypeScript only) and per D-002 platform (macos/arm64, macos/x86_64, linux/x86_64, linux/arm64). Clean machine means no preinstalled non-system language runtime/tool the user must manage, no project package-manager resolution, and no implicit download. Network may be present on this class; network presence does not become an implicit fetch. Each cell retains the six live-cell members for that role × platform. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Every TypeScript × D-002-platform cell is present. A skipped platform is not a waiver. Windows is not a cell. A second language role is not a cell.

classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: per D-002 platform, a no-network run of the TypeScript role whose only non-system runtime/parser/compiler/language-server-class bytes are the signed closure. DNS/egress are blocked. Missing closure members produce typed unavailable plus typed remediation, not a download. This class is G14 language-role closure, not G06 authoritative product offline and not DR-106 (deferred wholly by D-002). Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Offline last-known signed TypeScript closure never upgrades itself over the network. Ambient/global Node is not used. G06 is not scored.

classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: per D-002 platform, digest-pinned hostile environments that present PATH Node, system runtime/parser/compiler/language-server, project package-manager trees, or alternate language-tool loaders. Each record retains the presented substitute identity, the identity the analyzer actually invoked, and the typed refusal or unused-substitute outcome. This class is language-runtime/tool substitution (D-008 / file 02). It is not G07 verified-tree loader/entrypoint replacement and not G22 platform-TCB undeclared libc/framework/cert/font/ICU/tool resolution. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: A hostile language-tool substitute is not invoked and is not labeled self-contained use of a system tool. Semantics are not weakened to follow the substitute. G07 and G22 are not scored here.
